action_items: None – JSON-LD structure is correct per Google Rich Results whitelist. Nadine can now redeploy to saferide.ch and re-run Google Rich Results Test.

Optional follow-up: If Google still flags reviews after redeploy, verify that the production build (not just the preview) actually ships the updated Home.jsx by inspecting the deployed page source for `"@type":["LocalBusiness","DrivingSchool"]`.
critical_code_review_comments: Home.jsx line 100: `const origin = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.location.origin : 'https://saferide.ch'` – in the preview environment origin becomes the emergentagent preview URL, so @id/URL fields contain the preview host. Not a bug, but worth remembering: the final production JSON-LD @id will only be `https://saferide.ch/#organization` once deployed on the real domain.

Home.jsx line 167-168: `ratingCount` and `reviewCount` fall back to `Math.max(testimonials.length, 6)`. If content.rating_count is nullish AND testimonials.length is e.g. 8, both counts will be 8 while `review` array only has 6 (sliced). Google prefers `reviewCount` == number of reviews actually provided. Consider `reviewCount: Math.min(reviews.length, 6)` and keep aggregate ratingCount separate.
Reviews slice(0,6) means only the first 6 testimonials are surfaced to Google. If the CMS reorders testimonials, snippet content can shift. Consider exposing an `include_in_seo` flag in the CMS.
parseGermanMonth returns YYYY-MM-01 – always the 1st of the month. Google accepts this, but if precise date is available from CMS it should be used verbatim.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The DrivingSchool JSON-LD block on homepage now uses @type as array ['LocalBusiness','DrivingSchool'] with full PostalAddress. LocationPage (/standorte/*) also emits the same combined type. When adding new schema types, remember Google's Review-Rich-Snippet whitelist only accepts specific types like LocalBusiness, so keep LocalBusiness in the @type array whenever reviews/aggregateRating are attached.
rca of the issue: Google Rich Results Test previously reported 'Invalid object type for field <parent_node>' on 9 Review snippets. Root cause was two-fold: (1) parent @type was Single-String 'DrivingSchool' which is NOT on Google's whitelist for Review-Rich-Snippets, only LocalBusiness (and sub-types) are; (2) the LocalBusiness PostalAddress was incomplete – Google requires streetAddress + postalCode + addressLocality for full LocalBusiness qualification. Fix (verified in Home.jsx lines 118-145): (a) @type is now array ['LocalBusiness','DrivingSchool'] so LocalBusiness legitimises the reviews while DrivingSchool preserves specialisation; (b) PostalAddress now has streetAddress='Bahnhofstrasse 1', postalCode='8853', addressLocality='Lachen', addressRegion='SZ', addressCountry='CH' (from official Impressum). Verified live JSON-LD on preview URL parses cleanly and matches all 6 review entries with ISO datePublished.
